# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release of Release from Changelog or Tag receives security fixes.

Pin the action to the latest release tag or a reviewed commit SHA.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for security problems.

Report it privately through this repository's [Security tab](https://github.com/ysskrishna/changelog-release-action/security/advisories/new) and choose **Report a vulnerability**. Include the affected version or commit, steps to reproduce, and the impact you expect.

Once a fix is released, the advisory can credit the reporter unless they ask to stay anonymous.
